description: Machine catalog of the P1-M1-T02 3DXML samples (input to P1-M1-T04 build_manifest.py). Six redistributable files are committed under corpus/data/3dxml/; two are reference-only (no redistribution grant) and are NOT committed. Size/sha256 are NOT stored here on purpose: the builder derives them from the real on-disk bytes for committed files, which is the integrity anchor.

samples.geometry_notes: single cube part, ZIP 3DXML schema 4.0, one tessellated part rep (Abaqus_Geometry.3DRep)
single placed part ('blocks'), ZIP 3DXML schema 4.0, tessellated mesh rep; 1 Instance3D / 1 ReferenceRep
cycloidal gear train assembly, ZIP 3DXML schema 4.2; 17 Reference3D / 67 Instance3D / 25 .3DRep tessellated parts
satellite assembly, ZIP 3DXML schema 4.2; 72 Reference3D / 94 Instance3D / 66 .3DRep parts + MaterialDef/NameSetTree
single part (1 Reference3D) with 6 tessellated reps; ZIP 3DXML schema 4.2
pure ASCII 3DXML schema 4.3 (CATIA V5 2009); ProductStructure + material only, no embedded geometry rep observed in the file - structural/loader sample
